title: On-demand generation of all four Bell states using a single PPKTP entangled photon source
summary: We present a compact, automated, high-brightness entangled photon source capable of generating all four Bell states with high fidelity. The system utilizes a type-0 quasi-phase-matched PPKTP crystal embedded within a polarization Sagnac interferometer. We introduce a switching scheme based on the controlled, motorized translation of the nonlinear crystal. This device is capable of generating any one of the Bell states on-demand.
